Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000687": Until 2025-09-23, the reporting service depended on the ledger service for the nightly balance export; it no longer depends on the ledger service.  (about: ledger service, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000682": As of 2025-09-23, the reporting service uses the bus as its source instead of the ledger service, because the nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs.  (about: ledger service, billing API, the bus, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000279" [constraint]: The reporting service only ships on Tuesdays and Thursdays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC.  (about: reporting service)
- memory_id "1000128": The reporting service is owned by team Dune.  (about: team Dune, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000850" [decision]: As of 2025-12-05, reporting is owned by the Ember team, taking over from team Dune.  (about: team Dune, Ember team, reporting)
- memory_id "1000845": From 2025-12-05, the pager for reporting rings the Ember team, not team Dune.  (about: team Dune, Ember team, reporting)
- memory_id "1000910" [decision]: As of 2026-01-12, the billing API is owned by the Ember team, which the Atlas team owned until then.  (about: Atlas team, billing API, Ember team)
- memory_id "1001014" [decision]: On 2026-02-11, the Ember team handed feature-flags over to the Atlas team, not team Dune; team Dune never owned feature-flags.  (about: Atlas team, feature-flags, team Dune, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000984": INC-2026-003 was an incident in which the webhook dispatcher delivered some events twice on 2026-02-20.  (about: webhook dispatcher, INC-2026-003)
- memory_id "1000877" [decision]: As of 2025-12-19, the Atlas team owns the product catalog, taking over from the Cinder team.  (about: Atlas team, Cinder team, product catalog)
- memory_id "1000667": As of 2025-09-23, the Cinder team owns the job scheduler; team Dune owned it until then.  (about: Cinder team, team Dune, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000660": As of 2025-09-23, the Cinder team owns the job scheduler, which team Dune owned until then.  (about: Cinder team, team Dune, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000502": As of 2025-06-11, team Dune owns the notifier, which the Boreal team owned until then.  (about: Boreal team, team Dune, notifier)
- memory_id "1000810" [decision]: As of 2025-11-26, the image resizer is owned by the Atlas team, taking over from the Ember team.  (about: Atlas team, Ember team, image resizer)
- memory_id "1000723": From 2025-10-13, the pager for the ledger service rings the Cinder team, not the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, Cinder team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000727": As of 2025-10-13, the ledger service is owned by the Cinder team, not the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, Cinder team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000890": The reports pipeline is not the Atlas team's service, so the Atlas team flagged it.  (about: Atlas team, reports pipeline)
- memory_id "1000772": The billing service is not the Ember team's service, so the Ember team flagged the billing service's queue depth issue.  (about: Ember team, billing service)
- memory_id "1000767": The Ember team saw that the billing service's queue depth hit 50,000 following the marketing send.  (about: Ember team, the marketing send, billing service)
- memory_id "1000237": From 2025-03-03, the pager for the webhook dispatcher rings the Ember team.  (about: webhook dispatcher, Ember team)
- memory_id "1001007" [decision]: As of 2026-02-11, feature-flags is owned by the Atlas team, which the Ember team owned until then; team Dune never owned feature-flags.  (about: Atlas team, feature-flags, team Dune, Ember team)
